svg.title: KarWed
svg.desc: Postcard for KarWed (asp.net core saas, C#): Guests share photos at weddings and events, and they appear live on the big screen. QR code access, no app to install. Live slideshow pushed through SignalR. Moderation, venue branding and plan tiers. Built with C#, ASP.NET Core 8, SignalR, EF Core, SQL Server, Identity.
